{{recipe}}

This is a really easy chicken recipe for those people that don't have much experience in the kitchen.

== Ingredients ==

* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* Kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* Finely-grated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] both sides of chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper, and finely grated lemon zest.
#Place chicken on a 13x9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the chicken breasts and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in the center of a 400°F (200°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C).
#Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.
